# raff_vm_pricing (Data Source)

Lists VM pricing plans (size IDs to use as pricing_id when creating raff_vm).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String)
- `vm_type` (String) Filter: standard or premium.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `plans` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

- `memory_gib` (Number)

- `region` (String)
- `ssd_gib` (Number)

- `vm_type` (String)
